textField:
*Variables* can be used in games to count a score or number of lives for the player. When we create a variable, the first thing is to use a suitable *name*, so we can recognise it in our code-script. 

Then we must set the *initial* or starting value. For example we could start with 3 lives. 

We must then program a *condition* - a situation when the variable changes, for example of the player gets hit by an enemy. The *value* and nature of the change can also be decided, for example *losing* a life or 10% health. 

Finally we must determine the win or *lose* situation, for example when we have 0 lives we lose.
